methodology.AWL: Coxhead Academic Word List; all 570 published headwords from sublists 1–10 crosschecked (direct headword only), NOT an ETS test frequency list.
methodology.PHaVE: Garnier and Schmitt COCA-based 150 phrasal verb frequency rank; rank is for expression, not the teaching sense and NOT ETS.
methodology.automatedQuality: ID/schema, two examples, definition and Turkish gloss presence, rough morphology; lexical meaning, register, translation and collocation need expert human signoff.
methodology.noFalseNegative: No direct AWL headword match does not exclude membership via a related family form or relevance to everyday and academic English. Not in PHaVE top-150 does NOT mean infrequent in TOEFL.
